newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia RTS shares index closes at record 304.90.
newsitem.headline: Russia RTS shares index closes at record 304.90.

text.p: The Russian Trading System 24-share index closed at a record 304.90 on Monday, up from 292.67 at Friday's close and a record 293.33 set during the day on January 24, the NAUFOR brokers association said on Monday.
An official at NAUFOR said that total daily market turnover was $43.1 million, a healthy volume for the emerging market.
Utility UES rose to $0.1979 from $0.1817 at Friday's close.
LUKoil rose to $15.34 from $14.80, supported by news that it had signed a new deal with ARCO of the United States. Telecom Rostelekom broke through $4.00 to $4.065 from $3.720.
Domestic operators were seen as the primary driving force behind the rise, though some support from Western investors, the largest force in the market, was also seen.
"I expect this growth to continue. There is no correction looming for this week," said Pavel Gronbjerg, head of equities trading at Deutsche Morgan Grenfell in Moscow.

The market has been waiting for a downward correction and a buying opportunity for the last two weeks, but some players saw the latest rise as evidence that Western investors would have to accept the new, higher price levels.
The RTS index has risen more than 50 percent since the beginning of the year.
